name: comind
description: Team-shared AI context for Claude Code. Everyone works from the same pinned tools and the same committed context, instead of each developer rebuilding it in their own session.

plugins.name: comind
plugins.description: Installs and pins RTK, Caveman, GSD Core, graphify and the LSP plugins, then commits the derived context so a teammate's clone has it already. Run /comind-init.
